description: AIS maritime traffic data from the Barcelona School of Nautical Studies (FNB-UPC) is a data set deposited in CORA.Repositori de Dades de Recerca by its authors Anna Mujal-Colilles, Marcella Castells-Sanabra (Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya). This dataset comprises decoded and cleaned Automatic Identification System (AIS) data collected from antennas at the Barcelona School of Nautical Studies (FNB-UPC), part of the Polytechnic University of Catalonia. The data is organized by year and month, with CSV files containing information for 1 or 2 days, provided in zipped archives. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 126373148. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
